core_meaning.short_meaning: Silk cushions of Paradise; directly attested Qur'anic term.
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Namariq (نَمَارِق) is a Qur'anic feminine given name meaning 'luxurious cushions of Paradise' or 'pillows of celestial serenity'. It is directly attested in the Holy Qur'an in Surah al-Ghashiyah (88:15) depicting the sublime comfort, honor, and beauty prepared for the righteous in the eternal gardens.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: Plural of numruqah (a soft, elegant cushion or pillow of rich silk), signifying peaceful repose, dignity, and elevated comfort.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: In Surah al-Ghashiyah (88:15), Allah describes the blessings of Jannah: 'وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ' ('And cushions arrayed in ranks'). Classical commentators including Ibn Kathir and al-Qurtubi explain that namariq are cushions of vibrant silk lined up side by side for the believers to recline upon in joyful contemplation, symbolizing peace and honor.
